name: Jaysynth Orgochem Ltd
summary: Jaysynth Orgochem Ltd. engages in the manufacture and trading of dyes and dyes intermediates. It also involves in the production of organic chemicals, textile auxiliaries, pigments, resins, plasticizers, and emulsions. The company was founded by Sharadchandra Shoorji Kothari on October 5, 1973 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
